condition.narrative: Consistent with the Article III of the SBAA [or the Supplemental Provisions to the Project Document], the responsibility for the safety and security of the Implementing Partner and its personnel and property, and of UNDP’s property in the Implementing Partner’s custody, rests with the Implementing Partner. To this end, the Implementing Partner shall: a) put in place an appropriate security plan and maintain the security plan, taking into account the security situation in the country where the project is being carried; b) assume all risks and liabilities related to the Implementing Partner’s security, and the full implementation of the security plan.

Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

comment.narrative: Lifting the project out of the suspension mode and start implementation

As the project has been stalled for several years, review of the Project Document is under way is currently at advanced stage. Expected date for completion of the review process is January 2023. The purpose of the review is to determine whether the project rationale/logic, expected results (Outcome, Outputs, and activities), and budget against cost items are still relevant. And where it deems necessary and appropriate, amendments/adjustments shall be done accordingly. Moreover, the exercise will be instrumental to look into and assess implementation or execution arrangements and to propose appropriate and adequate ones to facilitate resumption of implementation.

Since the CEO endorsement of the Tsilima Project (PIMS4633) in August 2016 , the Government of Eritrea has not been able to initiate implementation of these two projects due to various institutional challenges. In the face of these challenges and to avoid the risk of cancellation of the projects, in May 2021, UNDP CO and the government agreed, in line with GEF rules and procedures, to suspend the projects to allow for appropriate arrangements to be put in place to facilitate initiation of project implementation activities. Based on the agreement reached between the UNDP CO and the Ministry of Land, Water and Environment of the government of the state of Eritrea, the project is under suspension.
